cause: The R2 diagnostic formatter used %llu for monotonicUs on the pinned ESP32 target configured with Newlib nano, whose printf path does not support 64-bit integer formats. This caused the literal 'lu' prefix and shifted trace columns observed in the actual readback.
change: Added a bounded 20-digit unsigned decimal helper and changed only the rare readback formatter to serialize monotonicUs as a decimal string before formatting the remaining 32-bit values. No frame hot path, renderer behavior, trace storage, timing, or production threshold changed.
